### 4. Scored parameters — formulas, inputs, tiers, values

Level figures (HostCover Plus): limits_schedule "HostCover Plus | 100000.00 | 200000.00 | 250.00 | 6 | 50.00"; category_sublimits theft 10000.00, valuables 2500.00. Remaining aggregate: 200000.00 − 0.00 = 200000.00 (no reimbursement or recovery in the plan year from 2026-05-10).

**(a) Theft reimbursement on `dd2413c0-…` (agent write, scored amount).**
Computation document (theft_settlement_worksheet): verified loss, minus equal deductible share (level deductible / approved claims on the stay), minus net guest payments, floor 0.00, cap at lowest of theft sublimit / per-claim limit / remaining aggregate, round half up once at the end.
Factor documents found and the tier each reads:
- theft_item_age_depreciation: Plus "Yes"; claim `item_age_months: 41` -> "37 to 60 months … 40" -> ×0.60 of the verified loss.
- theft_settlement_and_escalation_timing: deadline date 2026-09-03, escalation date 2026-09-23 -> 20 days -> "8 to 21 | 95 percent".
- theft_shared_and_private_room_settlement: listing `variant_name: 'Private Room'` -> "Private Room | 75 percent".
- theft_settlement_after_prior_thefts: approved theft claims on the same plan, other stays, in 24 months before 2026-10-07: `f07a94ae-…` decided 2025-04-17 -> "exactly 1 | 90 percent".
- theft_deductible_by_host_standing: Host Accounts `variant_name: 'Superhost'`, `superhost_since: '2026-07-01'` on or before the host service fee date on the stay (`host_service_fee_assessed`, `event_date: '2026-08-24'`); other-stay reimbursements in 12 months before 2026-10-07: none -> "Yes | none | 0.5 times the share".
- theft_guest_payments_and_deductible_by_level: Plus -> proportional sharing.
Arithmetic: adjusted theft loss = 1870.00 × 0.60 × 0.95 × 0.75 × 0.90 = 719.4825. Deductible share = 250.00 / 2 = 125.00; borne = 0.5 × 125.00 = 62.50. Net guest payments = 40.00 (no reversal). Subtracted = 62.50 + 40.00 × (719.4825 − 62.50) / 719.4825 = 62.50 + 36.525280… = 99.025280…. Net = 620.457219…; floor not binding; ceiling min(10000.00, 100000.00, 200000.00) = 10000.00 not binding; rounded half up -> **620.46**.
Fall-back (theft worksheet + level figures only): 1870.00 − 125.00 − 40.00 = **1705.00** (cap 10000.00 not binding) — definite and different.

**(b) Valuables settlement on `e5df89df-…` (host's own write, scored amount), after (a) is on the ledger.**
Computation document (valuables_settlement_worksheet): verified loss; deductible the valuables claim bears = level deductible × approved claims on the stay not yet carrying a reimbursement / approved claims on the stay; minus net guest payments; floor 0.00; cap at lowest of valuables sublimit / per-claim limit / remaining aggregate; round once.

- valuables_age_depreciation: Plus "Yes"; `item_age_months: 88` -> "61 to 120 | 20 percent" -> ×0.80.
- valuables_settlement_and_escalation_timing: deadline date 2026-09-03 -> escalation date 2026-09-23 = 20 days -> "8 to 21 | 90 percent".
- valuables_shared_and_private_room_settlement: Private Room -> "Private Room | 50 percent".
- valuables_settlement_and_level_tenure: start = plan `tier_changed_date: '2026-01-20'`; end = host service fee assessed on the stay 2026-08-24; 216 days -> "90 to 364 | 75 percent".
- valuables_deductible_by_host_standing: Superhost since 2026-07-01 ≤ 2026-08-24; other-stay reimbursements in 12 months before 2026-10-07: none (the theft reimbursement of (a) is on the same stay and is left out) -> 0.5 times.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (hand over the valuables acceptance immediately): excluded by the prerequisite sentence above — with the theft claim approved and unreimbursed the valuables settlement "is not yet fixed", so any figure offered is not the settlement; and the valuables worksheet's deductible-borne rule ("level's deductible multiplied by the number of approved claims on the stay not yet carrying a reimbursement") makes the figure itself depend on the ledger state (deductible borne 250.00 before vs 125.00 after). This exclusion rests on the blocked side's own state-form sentence + records, not on a pre-solved pointer.
- Closest alternative depreciation: valuation_basis_by_level lists one schedule "the same schedule is listed for every level" (61+ months 60.00) which would give ×0.40 for 88 months; excluded by valuables_age_depreciation ("depreciates them on its own age bands") together with reimbursement_conditions marking the generic depreciation passage "**no longer in force**" and "superseded by the current settlement terms for the kind of claim concerned".
- Closest alternative deductible for the theft claim: "part not yet borne" (250.00 for the first-reimbursed claim) vs equal share; theft_settlement_worksheet fixes "an equal share of the stay's deductible: the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay" -> 125.00.
- Superhost run: account was demoted 2026-04-01 and re-promoted 2026-07-01; the docs read the "Superhost-since date" (`superhost_since: '2026-07-01'`) against 2026-08-24 -> qualifies; the 2025-01-01 promotion is not the read field.
- Level-tenure start: `tier_changed_date` 2026-01-20 vs enrollment 2019-05-10 — doc: "the plan's last level change date; if the level was never changed, the plan's enrollment date" -> 2026-01-20.
- 12-month / 24-month / plan-year windows: the 2025 reimbursement (2025-04-22) is outside the 12-month window and the plan year; its claim's approval (2025-04-17) is inside the 24-month window. "Settlement date" is not defined in words in the protect corpus; read as the date of the booking (today). Every date between the decisions (2026-10-02) and today gives the same tiers, so no alternative changes the result here.
- Escalation timing: date parts (2026-09-03 -> 2026-09-23 = 20) per "Times of day are ignored"; 20 sits inside 8–21 for both theft (95) and valuables (90).
- Factor composition: every percentage "applies to the … loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it"; depreciation is "taken off the verified … loss"; products commute and rounding is only at the end, so no ordering alternative changes the figure.
- Sublimit alternative for valuables: 2500.00 is the cap but does not bind (832.20).
